item.description: Pick a color to use for the slider arrows that are used to navigate through each slide.
item.label: Arrow Color

item.description: This setting will turn on and off the navigation arrows.
item.label: Show Arrows

item.description: This setting will toggle visibility of CTA on mobile devices.
item.label: Show CTA On Mobile

item.description: This setting will toggle visibility of content on mobile devices.
item.label: Show Content On Mobile

item.description: When enabled, a background color is added behind the slider text to make it more readable atop background images.
item.label: Use Text Overlay

item.description: When enabled, a custom overlay color will be added above your background image and behind your slider content.
item.label: Use Background Overlay

contentOverlayUseBackground.description: Use the color picker to choose a color for the background overlay.
contentOverlayUseBackground.label: Background Overlay Color

contentOverlayUseText.description: Use the color picker to choose a color for the text overlay.
contentOverlayUseText.label: Text Overlay Color

item.description: Increasing the border radius will increase the roundness of the overlay corners. Setting this value to 0 will result in squared corners.
item.label: Text Overlay Border Radius

maxWidth.description: Setting a maximum width will prevent your element from ever surpassing the defined width value. Maximum width can be used in combination with the standard width setting. Maximum width supersedes the normal width value.
maxWidth.label: Content Max Width

width.description: By default, elements will extend the full width of their parent element. If you would like to set a custom static width, you can do so using this option.
width.label: Content Width

item.description: Pick a color to use for the dot navigation that appears at the bottom of the slider to designate which slide is active.
item.label: Dot Navigation Color

item.description: This setting will toggle visibility of Images/Video on mobile devices.
item.label: Show Image / Video On Mobile

item.description: If you would like the slider to slide automatically, without the visitor having to click the next button, enable this option and then adjust the rotation speed below if desired.
item.label: Automatic Animation

item.description: Turning this on will allow automatic sliding to continue on mouse hover.
item.label: Continue Automatic Slide on Hover

item.description: Here you can designate how fast the slider fades between each slide, if 'Automatic Animation' option is enabled above. The higher the number the longer the pause between each rotation.
item.label: Automatic Animation Speed (in ms)

item.description: Pick a color for the slide count and swipe label text in the swipe controls bar.
item.label: Controls Text Color

item.description: This setting will turn on and off the slider controls shown at the bottom of the slider.
item.label: Show Controls

item.description: Turn on and off the slide count text (e.g. 01 / 04) on the controls bar.
item.label: Show Slide Count

item.description: Turn on and off the swipe indicator text on the controls bar.
item.label: Show Swipe Label

item.description: Choose between the new swipe controls bar or the classic dot navigation.
item.label: Controls Style

item.description: Customize the swipe indicator text shown on the right side of the controls bar.
item.label: Swipe Label

module.description: Rotating carousel of slides combining background images, headings, and buttons.
module.name: divi/slider
module.title: Slider
